report_topic: Performance Audit of Implementation of 74th Constitutional Amendment Act
observations_summary: The audit found that the State Government did not fully empower Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) as envisioned by the 74th Constitutional Amendment Act, leading to statutory amendments not being implemented in spirit, delays in institutional mechanisms, significant shortfalls in fiscal transfers, and inadequate human resources. This hampered effective functioning, service delivery, and revenue generation, with ULBs utilizing only 69% of available funds.
